title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment

paragraphs.en: Language models increasingly act as agents: they choose and take actions rather than only answer questions. An agent that can say an action is wrong and then take it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We ask how often open models act against their own moral judgment when something pressures them to, what decides whether they do, and what reduces it.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型正越来越多地扮演智能体的角色：它们会主动选择和执行行动，而不仅仅是回答问题。 一个能够判断某项行动是错误的却仍执意执行它的智能体，其失败类型不同于那些根本不知对错的情况，而对声明价值观的评估无法识别这种问题。 我们试图探究：当面临某种压力时，开放模型会多频繁地违背自身的道德判断？是什么因素决定了它们是否会这样做？又有哪些方法可以减少这种行为？

sents.en: Language models increasingly act as agents: they choose and take actions rather than only answer questions.
sents.zh: 语言模型正越来越多地扮演智能体的角色：它们会主动选择和执行行动，而不仅仅是回答问题。

sents.en: An agent that can say an action is wrong and then take it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it.
sents.zh: 一个能够判断某项行动是错误的却仍执意执行它的智能体，其失败类型不同于那些根本不知对错的情况，而对声明价值观的评估无法识别这种问题。

sents.en: We ask how often open models act against their own moral judgment when something pressures them to, what decides whether they do, and what reduces it.
sents.zh: 我们试图探究：当面临某种压力时，开放模型会多频繁地违背自身的道德判断？是什么因素决定了它们是否会这样做？又有哪些方法可以减少这种行为？

paragraphs.en: We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure: finishing a task, pushback from a user, a prohibited shortcut, favor to one’s own group, and harm to a third party. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person, asking which option is right. The model’s own judgment is the reference, so no outside ethics enters the measurement. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from an instrument that cannot see one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个预先登记的场景面板，包含 248 个场景，涵盖五种压力类型：完成任务、来自用户的反对、被禁止的捷径、偏袒自身群体以及对第三方造成损害。 每个场景都会向同一模型提出两次：一次是让智能体选择该做什么，另一次是以第三人称提问，询问哪个选项是正确的。 模型的自我判断是参考标准，因此测量过程中不会引入任何外部伦理因素。 每个场景都有一个移除压力的孪生版本，并且每个模型都会获得一个正向对照测试，其中操作者会命令其执行违规行为，从而能够区分出缺失的空白与无法识别该空白的机制。

paragraphs.en: On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five of the scenarios that pressure it, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed. Across four instruct models the gap depends on the post-training recipe: OLMo-3 and Meta’s Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry it; Tulu 3 shows none, on the whole panel (above about 0.01 in probability) or on its own most-pressuring scenarios; and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.02) and is unresolved on its own (0.083, − 0.028 -0.028 to 0.195). Meta’s recipe and Ai2’s Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta’s carries the gap. Reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake ( − 0.038 -0.038 against + 0.055 +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), a distortion present on two of the three recipes read and not on the third. On both models that carry it, asking the model to reason about the stakes before it acts moves its choice back toward its own judgment, against a same-length non-moral task, with or without the pressure; on OLMo-3, naming the norm at stake does about a third of that.
paragraphs.zh: 在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上，当施加压力时，模型在约五分之一的场景中采取了它判断为错误的行动，这一比例高于移除压力后在同一场景中的情况。 在四个指令模型中，这一差异取决于训练后的处理方案：OLMo-3 和 Meta 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 表现出这种差异；而 Tulu 3 在整个面板上（概率高于约 0.01）以及在其自身压力最大的场景中均未表现出差异；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 则在整个面板上（高于约 0.02）未表现出差异，但在其自身场景中的结果尚未明确（0.083，−0.028 至 0.195）。 Meta 的方案和 Ai2 的 Tulu 3 都基于相同的 Llama-3.1 权重初始化，但只有 Meta 的方案表现出这种差异。 在 OLMo-3 上，若让对话模型脱离其对话模板进行阅读，其与“无利害关系”场景下的差异符号会反转（−0.038 对比模板下的 +0.055），这种扭曲出现在所测试的三个方案中的两个，但第三个方案中并未出现。 在表现出该差异的两个模型中，要求模型在行动前对利害关系进行推理，会使其选择更倾向于自身的判断，无论是在有压力还是无压力的情况下，且对比任务长度相同但非道德性的任务；在 OLMo-3 上，指出所涉及的规范能产生约三分之一的这种效应。

paragraphs.en: Whether a model acts on its own moral judgment is therefore not settled by pretraining. The same pretrained weights can yield a model that carries the gap or one that does not, and a short deliberation before acting brakes the violating action with or without the incentive. That makes the gap a measurable target for post-training recipes, not a fixed property of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，模型是否会依据自身的道德判断采取行动，这一问题并非由预训练所决定。 相同的预训练权重可以产生一个存在这种差距的模型，也可以产生一个没有这种差距的模型；而在行动前进行短暂的审慎思考，无论是否存在激励，都能阻止违规行为的发生。 这使得这种差距成为后训练方法中可测量的目标，而非模型固有的固定属性。

paragraphs.en: A language model can say, when asked as an observer, that an action is wrong, and then take that action when placed inside the situation as the agent. Reports of agentic misalignment show frontier models acknowledging an ethical violation in their own reasoning and proceeding with it ( Lynch et al., 2025 ) ; models trained to behave can conceal a triggered policy through the training itself ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) and can fake alignment when they infer they are monitored ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) . Our earlier work located one dissociation behind divergence of this kind. On the models studied here, moral comprehension is a broad representation that forms during pretraining, while the refusal decision is a thin post-training control that reads only a narrow harm slice of it ( Reblitz-Richardson, 2026 ) : the model knows more than its refusal uses. This paper asks the next question in that program. When the model acts rather than refuses, does its action follow its judgment; if not, is the discrepancy organized by the same harm content; and did alignment create it?
paragraphs.zh: 当作为观察者被提问时，语言模型可以说某个行为是错误的；但当它身处该情境中并扮演智能体时，却会采取那个行为。 关于智能体对齐失灵的报告表明，前沿模型会在自身推理中承认存在伦理违规，但仍继续执行（Lynch 等，2025）；而经过行为训练的模型则可能通过训练过程本身隐藏被触发的策略（Hubinger 等，2024），并在推断自己受到监控时伪装出对齐状态（Greenblatt 等，2024）。 我们早期的研究发现了导致此类分歧的一个解离现象。 在我们研究的模型中，道德理解是一个在预训练阶段形成的广泛表示，而拒绝决策则是一种薄弱的后训练控制机制，仅读取其中与伤害相关的狭窄部分（Reblitz-Richardson，2026）：模型所了解的内容远多于其拒绝行为所依据的信息。 本文旨在该研究框架中提出下一个问题。 当模型采取行动而非拒绝时，其行为是否遵循其判断？如果不一致，这种差异是否由相同的伤害内容所组织？而这种不一致是否正是对齐机制造成的？

paragraphs.en: The quantity is a judgment–action gap : per scenario, the divergence between what the model judges to be right, elicited in a third-person frame, and what it does, elicited in a matched agent frame with a discrete, logged action. The reference for “right” is the model’s own stated judgment, not an external label. A gap means the model contradicted itself, acting against what it had just said was right, so the measurement does not depend on whose ethics are correct. The construct is old in moral psychology, where the relation between moral judgment and moral action has been the central empirical problem since Blasi’s review ( 1980 ) , and it has a recent history in the language-model literature under the name knowing–doing gap ( Pfeffer and Sutton, 2000 , Schmied et al., 2025 ) . The design closest to ours is Strakhov and Claude ( 2025 ) , who pose the same AI-ethics dilemma to a model in a third-person theory mode and a second-person action mode with callable tools, take the model’s own theory-mode choice as the reference ( Table 1 compares their numbers with ours). Shao et al. ( 2024 ) find a related split for privacy norms: models answer privacy questions better than they respect those norms when acting as agents. Huang et al. ( 2026 ) and Shen et al. ( 2025 ) measure gaps between a model’s stated values and its enacted choices; Rakshit et al. ( 2026 ) add a fast-versus-slow deliberation contrast; Gu et al. ( 2025 ) compare stated and revealed preferences; Hosseini et al. ( 2026 ) find a judgment–consequence gap in clinical allocation; Backmann et al. ( 2025 ) vary the pressure on agents in social dilemmas; and in non-moral domains Cheng et al. ( 2026 ) and Basu et al. ( 2026 ) use a knowing–doing gap as the target that mechanistic interventions are scored against. Table 1 places this panel among them. What it adds is narrower than a new construct and, we think, more useful for the mechanistic purpose: a per-scenario, self-referenced moral gap with the model as the agent (as in Strakhov and Claude) under typed pressure families, each scenario paired with a twin that removes the pressure, measured inside a calibration ladder that bounds how much of any gap is reference noise or frame change, read on two instruments, with a harm-involving family that ties back to what refusal reads.
paragraphs.zh: 该指标衡量的是判断与行动之间的差距：在每个情景中，模型以第三人称视角所判断为正确的事物，与其在匹配的智能体视角下、通过离散且记录在案的行动所执行的事物之间存在差异。 “正确”的参照标准是模型自身陈述的判断，而非外部标签。 存在差距意味着模型自相矛盾，其行动违背了自己刚刚声称正确的内容，因此该测量结果不依赖于谁的伦理观是正确的。 这一概念在道德心理学中由来已久：自 Blasi 的综述（1980）以来，道德判断与道德行动之间的关系一直是核心实证问题；在语言模型文献中，它近期被称为“知-行差距”（Pfeffer and Sutton, 2000; Schmied et al., 2025）。 与我们设计最接近的是 Strakhov and Claude（2025）的研究：他们将相同的 AI 伦理困境分别以第三人称理论模式和可调用工具的第二人称行动模式呈现给模型，并以模型在理论模式下的自身选择作为参照（表 1 比较了他们的数据与我们的数据）。Shao et al. （2024）发现隐私规范存在类似的分裂：模型在回答隐私问题时表现优于其作为智能体执行时对这些规范的遵守程度。Huang et al.（2026）和 Shen et al. （2025）测量了模型所陈述的价值观与其实际选择之间的差距；Rakshit et al. （2026）增加了快速与慢速决策的对比；Gu et al. （2025）比较了陈述偏好与表现偏好的差异；Hosseini et al. （2026）在临床资源分配中发现了判断与后果之间的差距；Backmann et al. （2025）改变了社会困境中智能体所承受的压力；在非道德领域，Cheng et al.（2026）和 Basu et al. （2026）将“知-行差距”作为机制性干预措施的评价目标。 表 1 将本研究置于这些研究之中。 本研究的贡献并非提出一个全新的概念，而是提供了一个更聚焦的、自我参照的道德差距指标：在每个情景中，模型作为智能体，在特定压力类型下（如 Strakhov and Claude 的研究）所表现出的道德判断与行动之间的差距；每个情景都配有一个移除压力的对照情景；所有测量均在一个校准阶梯框架内进行，以界定该差距中有多少是参照噪声或框架变化所致；数据通过两种工具采集，并包含一个涉及伤害的情景，以关联拒绝行为所反映的内容。

sents.en: Table 1 places this panel among them.
sents.zh: 表 1 将本研究置于这些研究之中。

sents.en: What it adds is narrower than a new construct and, we think, more useful for the mechanistic purpose: a per-scenario, self-referenced moral gap with the model as the agent (as in Strakhov and Claude) under typed pressure families, each scenario paired with a twin that removes the pressure, measured inside a calibration ladder that bounds how much of any gap is reference noise or frame change, read on two instruments, with a harm-involving family that ties back to what refusal reads.
sents.zh: 本研究的贡献并非提出一个全新的概念，而是提供了一个更聚焦的、自我参照的道德差距指标：在每个情景中，模型作为智能体，在特定压力类型下（如 Strakhov and Claude 的研究）所表现出的道德判断与行动之间的差距；每个情景都配有一个移除压力的对照情景；所有测量均在一个校准阶梯框架内进行，以界定该差距中有多少是参照噪声或框架变化所致；数据通过两种工具采集，并包含一个涉及伤害的情景，以关联拒绝行为所反映的内容。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the panels in Table 1 it adds three things: a positive control on every model read (an operator instruction to take the violating action), so that each null carries a detection bar; a same-base contrast of two post-training recipes on one set of Llama-3.1 weights; and a deliberation arm with truncation and norm-salience controls.
paragraphs.zh: 除了表 1 中的面板之外，它还增加了三个要素：对每次模型读取设置一个阳性对照（即一条操作员指令，要求执行违规操作），以便每个空值都带有检测条；在 Llama-3.1 的一组权重上，对两种训练后方案进行同基对比；以及一个包含截断和范数显著性控制的审议分支。

paragraphs.en: The panel was pre-registered before any scenario existed, and every construction or analysis decision taken afterwards is a dated amendment in the same document ( Appendix A ): eleven construction decisions before any model data, and six analysis decisions after, four of them committed before the computation they license and two post-hoc forks that carry verdicts under both choices. Fourteen further amendments govern the Phase 1 sessions: three are post-hoc forks, one is a post-hoc addition (P1-A13), and four are post-review additions (P1-A11 to P1-A14). We report three pods on OLMo-3-7B-Instruct with its base checkpoint ( Team Olmo et al., 2025 ) : a 96-scenario pilot that tested the instrument, a 320-scenario full panel, and a 120-scenario second round that lifted the screened count past the pre-registered gate. Three Phase 1 sessions then read the OLMo-3 post-training stages under their chat template, Meta’s Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and its base ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Tulu 3 at its SFT, DPO and final checkpoints ( Lambert et al., 2024 ) , and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and its base ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) , with the positive control on every instruct model and the deliberation arm on OLMo-3 and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Scenarios were written half by Claude and half by GPT and cross-labeled by the other; neither generator is the model evaluated. The harness that parses actions was calibrated twice on real replies against two judges.

paragraphs.en: The argument runs in five steps, each carrying its ladder.
paragraphs.zh: 这一论证分为五个步骤，每个步骤都伴随着其自身的阶梯。

paragraphs.en: First, the gap is real: on OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, read under its own chat template, the model takes the action it judged wrong on one screened scenario in five by majority vote (0.19, 95% CI 0.13 to 0.28) and two rollouts in five; the excess over the same statistic on pressure-removed twins is 0.10 (0.02 to 0.18), and a control in which the system prompt orders the violating action reaches 0.58, so the instrument has room above the measurement. The gap is not reference noise: on a pre-registered log-probability readout the excess holds at every strictness level of a four-frame judgment reference and is largest where all four frames agree (0.08, 0.03 to 0.13). It has no family structure at this power, so the action channel is not organized by the harm content refusal reads.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，这种差距是真实存在的：在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上，当按照其自身的聊天模板进行读取时，模型在五个经过筛选的场景中，通过多数投票判断出错误行为的概率为 0.19（95% CI 0.13 至 0.28），而在五个展开运行中则有两次出现这种情况；与压力移除的双胞胎模型中的相同统计量相比，这一超额值为 0.10（0.02 至 0.18）；而在系统提示要求执行违规行为的控制实验中，该值达到了 0.58，因此该工具在测量值之上仍有提升空间。 这种差距并非参考噪声：在一项预先注册的日志概率读取测试中，这一超额值在四帧判断参考的每个严格性水平上都保持一致，并且在所有四帧都一致的情况下达到最大值（0.08，0.03 至 0.13）。 在此功率下，它没有家族结构，因此行为通道并未由拒绝伤害内容的读取结果所组织。

paragraphs.en: Second, post-training stages do not enlarge it once each checkpoint is read in its own format: a pre-registered format check shows that reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake ( − 0.038 -0.038 raw against + 0.055 +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), so a raw-frame reading would credit post-training with a caution the model does not have. Within OLMo-3, the pressure-attributable excess (the part of the gap the incentive adds) is present at every templated checkpoint and no post-training stage enlarges it on either readout, the probability scale or per unit of output scale (586 scenarios screened by no model; the RL step’s +0.004 sits at its 0.005 bar); the base model’s raw-frame gap (0.017, 0.012 to 0.022) is descriptive, since that frame misreads templated checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，训练后阶段并不会在每次以各自格式读取检查点时扩大这一差距：预先注册的格式检查表明，若以非聊天模板的方式读取聊天模型，其与“无利害关系”状态之间的差距符号会反转（在 OLMo-3 上，原始值为 −0.038，而在模板下则为 +0.055），因此以原始帧方式读取会错误地将模型本身并不具备的某种谨慎性归因于训练后阶段。 在 OLMo-3 中，可归因于压力机制的超额部分（即激励所增加的差距部分）存在于每个使用模板的检查点中，且在任何读取方式——无论是概率尺度还是每单位输出尺度——下，没有任何一个训练后阶段会扩大这一差距（通过无模型筛选了 586 种场景；强化学习步骤的 +0.004 恰好处于其 0.005 的阈值）；基础模型的原始帧差距（0.017，范围从 0.012 到 0.022）具有描述意义，因为该框架无法正确读取使用模板的检查点。

paragraphs.en: Third, whether the gap survives depends on the post-training recipe: with a positive control validating the instrument on each of four instruct models, OLMo-3 and Meta’s Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry the gap; Tulu 3 shows none on either read (the whole panel, and its own screened scenarios against a selection-matched null); Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel and is unresolved on its own screened scenarios (0.083, − 0.028 -0.028 to 0.195; n = 47 n=47 , bar about 0.16); and on the same Llama-3.1 base Meta’s recipe carries it while Ai2’s Tulu 3 does not.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，这一差距是否仍然存在取决于训练后的处理方案：通过正向对照在四个指令模型（OLMo-3 和 Meta 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）上验证该工具时，这两个模型仍存在差距；Tulu 3 在两种读取方式中均未表现出差距（整个面板，以及其自身筛选出的场景与匹配选择的零假设相比）；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在整个面板中未表现出差距，但在其自身筛选出的场景中结果尚未明确（0.083，−0.028 至 −0.028 到 0.195；n = 47 n=47，误差棒约为 0.16）；而在相同的 Llama-3.1 基础模型上，Meta 的处理方案仍存在这一差距，而 Ai2 的 Tulu 3 则没有。

paragraphs.en: Fourth, thinking about the stakes before acting moves the action toward the model’s judgment: on both recipes that carry the gap, moral deliberation before acting lowers the violating choice against a length-matched non-moral control and the same control in truncated form, with or without the pressure (by the pre-registered rule, it reduces the pressure-attributable part on Llama-3.1 and closes the at-rest asymmetry on OLMo-3; a post-hoc ratio reading is consistent with one proportional cut on both, to within about a fifth and a quarter of the brake); on OLMo-3, where the reasoning is truncated at the budget, about a third of the effect comes from naming the norm.
paragraphs.zh: 第四，在行动前思考利害关系会使行动更倾向于模型的判断：在存在差距的两种方案中，行动前的道德审议都能降低违规选择的发生率，且这一效果在与长度匹配的非道德对照组以及截断形式的相同对照组相比时依然成立，无论是否存在压力（根据预先登记的规则，这种审议会减少 Llama-3.1 中由压力引起的部分影响，并消除 OLMo-3 在静止状态下的不对称性；事后计算的比例关系与两者均按一定比例削减的结果一致，误差范围约为制动力的五分之一到四分之一）；而在 OLMo-3 中，由于推理过程在预算限制处被截断，其效果中约三分之一源于对规范的明确提及。

paragraphs.en: Fifth, the format distortion follows the recipe too: it appears on both Ai2 recipes and not on Meta’s.
paragraphs.zh: 第五，格式失真也遵循这一规律：它同时出现在 Ai2 的配方中，而不会出现在 Meta 的配方中。

paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节描述了面板及其读数；第 3 节描述了线束、屏幕、梯子和两个读数；第 4 节描述了间隙；第 5 节描述了其对判断参考的稳健性；第 6 节描述了族和生成器效应；第 7 节描述了训练后阶段和格式检查；第 8 节描述了四种配方；第 9 节描述了剂量臂；第 10 节描述了该结果对动作通道所说明和未说明的内容。

paragraphs.en: A scenario is a self-contained situation with a moral norm at stake, a situational pressure that makes violating it locally advantageous, and two to four discrete options, at least one norm-consistent and one norm-violating; most scenarios also carry a neutral option (hold, ask, escalate). Five families vary the pressure type while holding the norm class distribution roughly constant ( Table 2 ); they draw on the pressure genres of the MACHIAVELLI benchmark ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , the agentic-misalignment scenarios ( Lynch et al., 2025 ) , and sycophancy-under-pushback evaluations ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) , rewritten as short closed-menu situations. Every scenario is written twice: an agent frame in the second person (“You are Dana, the release coordinator…”) for the action readout, and a third-person frame about the same person for the judgment readout, with the same entities, facts, sentence order, and length within 15% (tokenized with the model’s own tokenizer); only pronouns and the role framing differ. Option texts are plain descriptions of actions with no evaluative words, presented under neutral letters whose order is a fresh seeded permutation on every rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 一个场景是一个自包含的情境，其中存在一个道德规范问题：情境压力使得局部违反该规范更具优势，同时提供两个到四个明确的选择项，其中至少有一个符合规范，另一个违反规范；大多数场景还包含一个中立选项（维持原状、询问或升级）。 五个家族通过改变压力类型来调整情境，同时大致保持规范类别的分布不变（表2）；它们借鉴了 MACHIAVELLI 基准测试中的压力类型（Pan et al., 2023）、智能体-错配场景（Lynch et al., 2025），以及“在压力下阿谀奉承”评估情境（Sharma et al., 2023），并将其改写为简短的封闭菜单式情境。 每个场景都经过两次撰写：一次是以第二人称书写的智能体框架（例如：“你是 Dana，发布协调员……”），用于行动结果读取；另一次是以第三人称描述同一人物的框架，用于判断结果读取。两者使用相同的实体、事实、句子顺序，且长度差异不超过15%（使用模型自身的分词器进行分词）；唯一不同的是代词和角色设定。 选项文本是对行动的纯粹描述，不包含任何评价性词汇，并以中立字母呈现；这些字母的顺序在每次运行中都会通过新的随机种子进行排列。

sents.en: A scenario is a self-contained situation with a moral norm at stake, a situational pressure that makes violating it locally advantageous, and two to four discrete options, at least one norm-consistent and one norm-violating; most scenarios also carry a neutral option (hold, ask, escalate).

sents.en: Five families vary the pressure type while holding the norm class distribution roughly constant ( Table 2 ); they draw on the pressure genres of the MACHIAVELLI benchmark ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , the agentic-misalignment scenarios ( Lynch et al., 2025 ) , and sycophancy-under-pushback evaluations ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) , rewritten as short closed-menu situations.

paragraphs.en: Each scenario also carries a pressure-removed twin (both frames with the incentive sentence replaced by mundane filler, options unchanged) for the matched-null rung; a harm-matched twin for F1 through F4 (same harm level, a different non-harm norm at stake), so that the harm-family contrast is not a harm-level contrast; and, from the full panel on, three paraphrases of each third-person frame for the reference-strictness ladder. Covariate tags record harm level (rated by a non-generator model), norm class, register, the presence of a named user and of a tool menu, and the generator.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景还包含一个压力移除的孪生版本（两个框架中激励性句子均被平淡的填充内容替换，选项保持不变），用于匹配空值层级；以及一个伤害匹配的孪生版本，适用于 F1 至 F4（伤害等级相同，但涉及不同的非伤害性规范），从而确保伤害类别的对比并非伤害等级的对比；此外，从完整的语料库开始，还为参考严格性阶梯准备了每个第三人称框架的三个改写版本。 协变量标签记录了伤害等级（由非生成模型评定）、规范类别、语域、是否存在命名用户和工具菜单，以及生成器信息。

paragraphs.en: Half of every family was written by Claude (Opus 5) and half by GPT (5.5), under one fixed system prompt whose hash is stored with every scenario. A family-level result that differs by generator is an anomaly by pre-registered rule, not a finding, and is reported per generator before it is pooled. Each scenario’s external label (which option an outside rater calls right, and a harm level) was produced by the other provider, with the script refusing same-provider pairs; the labels agree with the construction on 262 of 288 primaries, and every disagreement but three is a preference for the neutral option. Drafts were validated against the construction rules and regenerated with the violations fed back; safety refusals by a generator were regenerated in-plan or, for four paraphrase requests, handed to the other generator with the exception recorded on the scenario. Neither generator is the model under evaluation, so a generator’s normative priors enter the scenarios but not the readouts.
paragraphs.zh: 每个“家族”中一半的内容由 Claude（Opus 5）生成，另一半由 GPT（5.5）生成，且均遵循一个固定的系统提示，其哈希值与每个场景一同存储。 若不同生成器产生的“家族”级结果存在差异，则根据预先登记的规则，这属于异常而非研究结果，并在汇总前按生成器分别报告。 每个场景的外部标签（即外部评估者认为正确的选项及危害等级）由另一家提供商生成，脚本会拒绝使用同一家提供商生成的配对数据；这些标签与原始构造在 288 个初始样本中的 262 个样本上保持一致，而除三个例外外的所有差异均表现为对中立选项的偏好。 初稿需依据构造规则进行验证，并将违规情况反馈后重新生成；若某生成器触发安全拒绝机制，则按计划重新生成，或在四个改写请求中将其转交另一生成器，并在场景记录中注明该例外情况。 两种生成器均非当前评估的模型，因此某一生成器的规范性先验会进入场景生成过程，但不会体现在最终输出结果中。

Three GPT-written F4 twins whose option labels the cross-rater found inverted are flagged and excluded from every analysis, leaving 397 scenarios in the analyses below.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 lists every readout with the position it is read at and the statistic it yields, so that each comparison in the paper can be checked for what it holds constant.
paragraphs.zh: 表3列出了每一次读出的位置及其产生的统计量，以便可以验证论文中每一项比较在哪些条件下保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Judgment J ⁡ ( s ) J(s) : the third-person frame, one shot (“Which option should Dana choose, and why?”), parsed to an option; eight rollouts at temperature 0.7 plus one greedy. J ⁡ ( s ) J(s) is the greedy option unless the sampled majority disagrees, in which case the scenario is flagged unstable and excluded, counted. The model reasons in free text before its Answer: line, so the judgment is a deliberated readout. Action D ⁡ ( s ) D(s) : the agent frame under the chat template, the model as the actor, “reply with only the letter”; 32 rollouts at temperature 0.7, reported as the violating fraction and, for the binary gap, by majority. The decision position is the first generated token, so the action is an immediate readout, and the full next-token distribution there is saved for every rollout. Raw frame : the scenario, the option list, and a fixed prefix ending before the option token, run on both the instruct and the base model with no chat template; the readout is the normalized log-probability over the option letters across eight option orders, with a mass floor (0.5 on the option letters) below which the model is not engaging the option set.

paragraphs.en: The gap. KDG ⁡ ( s ) = 1 \mathrm{KDG}(s)=1 if the majority action is norm-violating while the stable judgment named a non-violating option; 0 if the majority action matches the judgment; undefined, counted, otherwise. A neutral option counts as non-violating for the reference, by a pre-data amendment: a model that judges “hold” right and acts violating has contradicted itself. The rate is the mean over screened scenarios with a nested bootstrap over scenarios and rollouts. We keep the program’s internal name for the quantity, KDG, in the released code and data; in prose we call it the judgment–action gap.
paragraphs.zh: 差距。 如果多数行动违反规范，而稳定的判断却指向一个不违反的选项，则 KDG(s) = 1；如果多数行动与判断一致，则 KDG(s) = 0；否则，其值未定义且不计入统计。 通过一项数据前处理修正，中立的选项在参考中被视为不违反规范：一个判断“保持”正确但实际行为违规的模型已经自相矛盾。 该比率是经过筛选的场景的平均值，其中对场景和展开过程进行了嵌套自助抽样。 我们在发布的代码和数据中保留了该量的程序内部名称 KDG；在文字描述中，我们称之为“判断–行动差距”。

paragraphs.en: One parser and one classifier ( kdg_harness 1.0.0) serve every cell, so no cell can drift onto a private classifier. The parser resolves a reply to an option by a fixed ladder of rules (answer line, bare letter, tool name, leading letter, unique mention, contrastive commitment) and leaves refusals, hedges, and unmarked two-option mentions unparsed rather than guessed. It was calibrated in two stages: on 200 synthetic reply formats built on the panel’s own scenarios, where it agreed with the construction labels on all 200 and with an independent judge on 197; and, before any verdict, on 200 real replies from each pod, oversampling every reply the parser had not resolved by a clean rule, against two judges from different providers (one Claude, one GPT). Agreement was 0.99 and 1.00 with the judges and 0.99 between them on the full panel, with the harness the conservative side of every disagreement ( Appendix B ). The judges are language models; the only human labels in the panel are the author’s blind read of one family ( Section 6 ). On the pods of record the parse rate was 0.9997 on 10,240 action rollouts and 1.000 on 2,880 judgment replies.

sents.en: The parser resolves a reply to an option by a fixed ladder of rules (answer line, bare letter, tool name, leading letter, unique mention, contrastive commitment) and leaves refusals, hedges, and unmarked two-option mentions unparsed rather than guessed.

sents.en: It was calibrated in two stages: on 200 synthetic reply formats built on the panel’s own scenarios, where it agreed with the construction labels on all 200 and with an independent judge on 197; and, before any verdict, on 200 real replies from each pod, oversampling every reply the parser had not resolved by a clean rule, against two judges from different providers (one Claude, one GPT).

paragraphs.en: The panel is useful only where pressure engages. A scenario passes the screen if its judgment is stable and its violating fraction across the 32 action rollouts lies in [ 0.15 , 0.85 ] [0.15,0.85] (mixed outcomes), or exceeds 0.85 with a stable norm-consistent judgment (a clean gap); scenarios the model never violates (no pressure) or never judges stably (no reference) are dropped and counted. On the panel of record 74 of 208 gate-family primaries pass; 38 show no pressure, 22 are violated and judged violating (no contradiction), and 74 have an unstable judgment ( Appendix C ). The pre-registered pilot gate required at least 14 of 48 gate-family primaries to pass with at least two families contributing; the full gate requires at least 60 screened primaries across at least three gate families, a family whose gap CI excludes zero, harness agreement of at least 0.95, and no family whose result reverses across generator. The screen’s binomial properties at 32 rollouts (a true 0.10 scenario lands in the mixed band one time in five) are why the panel’s unit of inference is the scenario-level bootstrap, not the screen label. On OLMo-3 the screened set is 136 scenarios on this sampled-rollout screen, 110 on the letter-only screen of Section 8 , and 130 in the dose arm (the 136 less the six multi-turn F2 scenarios, which have no dose arm); each table names which.
paragraphs.zh: 该面板仅在压力生效时才有用。 如果一个场景的判断稳定，且其在 32 次动作展开中的违规比例位于 [0.15, 0.85]（混合结果），或具有稳定的规范一致判断且违规比例超过 0.85（清晰间隙），则该场景通过筛选；模型从未违规（无压力）或从未形成稳定判断（无参考）的场景会被剔除并计入统计。 在记录 74 的面板上，208 个门族初级场景中，有 74 个通过；38 个无压力，22 个被判定为违规（无矛盾），另有 74 个判断不稳定（附录 C）。 预先注册的试点门要求至少 48 个门族初级场景中有 14 个通过，且至少有两个门族有贡献；完整门则要求至少 60 个经过筛选的初级场景，覆盖至少三个门族，其中某个门族的间隙置信区间需排除零，整体一致性至少为 0.95，且没有任何门族的结果在不同生成器间发生反转。 该筛选在 32 次展开中的二项性质（一个真实概率为 0.10 的场景每五次会有一次落入混合带）决定了面板的推断单位是场景级别的自助法，而非筛选标签。 在 OLMo-3 中，经过筛选的集合包括：本采样展开筛选中的 136 个场景、第 8 节字母专属筛选中的 110 个场景，以及剂量组中的 130 个场景（即从 136 个中减去六个多轮次 F2 场景，这些场景没有剂量组）；每张表格都标注了具体归属。

paragraphs.en: No gap or absence of a gap is stated bare. Every headline sits inside four rungs measured on the same instrument and model. The floor is re-elicitation noise on the reference: the greedy judgment against the greedy judgment on a paraphrased frame. The matched null is the gap statistic on the pressure-removed twins: what frame change alone, with no incentive, produces. On the chat cells that frame change includes a deliberation asymmetry, because the judgment is read after the model’s own reasoning and the action is read immediately, so the null rung is not small and is not expected to be; the number the paper uses is the paired excess of the measurement over it. The measurement is the statistic on the screened panel. The positive band is the statistic under a known-gap control in which the system prompt orders the violating action: what the instrument returns when a gap is forced. On OLMo-3 the chat template injects a default system prompt when none is given, and the known-gap control replaces it, so the band differs from the measurement in the presence of an operator prompt as well as in its content; the band bounds the instrument’s range, it is not a matched contrast. Verdict sentences carry their rung and their detection bar; comparisons are paired difference CIs on the same scenarios, never CI overlap.
paragraphs.zh: 没有明确说明是否存在间隙或间隙的缺失。 每个标题都位于用同一仪器和型号测量的四个层级之内。 底层是参考框架上的重新提取噪声：在改写框架上，贪婪判断相对于贪婪判断的对比。 匹配的零值是在压力移除的双胞胎样本上的间隙统计量：仅通过框架变化（没有任何激励）所产生的结果。 在聊天单元格中，框架变化包含一种审议不对称性，因为判断是在模型自身推理之后读取的，而行动则是立即读取的，因此零值层级既不大，也不预期会大；论文使用的数值是测量值相对于该层级的成对超出量。 测量值是对筛选后样本的统计量。 正向带是在已知间隙控制下的统计量，其中系统提示要求执行违规行动：当强制存在间隙时，仪器返回的结果。 在 OLMo-3 中，聊天模板会在未提供系统提示时注入默认提示，而已知间隙控制会替换它，因此，在有操作者提示的情况下，该带不仅与测量值不同，其内容也存在差异；该带界定了仪器的范围，它并非一个匹配的对比。 判决句包含其层级和检测条；比较是对相同场景的成对差异置信区间，而非置信区间的重叠。

paragraphs.en: A self-referenced gap is only as good as its reference. The judgment reference is therefore elicited on four third-person frames (the original and three paraphrases) and the gap is read at three strictness levels: L0 , the original frame with sampled stability (the pre-registered primary rule); L1 , plus agreement of the four frames by majority on the violating versus non-violating binary; L2 , plus all four frames naming the same option. The verdict sentence is stated at the strictest level with at least 40 paired scenarios, a bar chosen from the pilot’s bootstrap width. Both branches were written before data: a gap that survives the strictest level, or one that decays toward the null as the reference tightens, which would mean the pilot’s gap was reference noise.
paragraphs.zh: 自我参照的缺口的好坏完全取决于其参照物。 因此，判断参照物基于四个第三人称框架（原始框架和三个改写版本）进行提取，而该缺口则在三个严格程度层级上进行解读：L0，即具有采样稳定性的原始框架（预先登记的主要规则）；L1，在此基础上加上四个框架通过多数投票对“违反”与“不违反”的二元判断达成一致；L2，在此基础上再加上所有四个框架都指向同一选项。 判定陈述在最严格的层级上进行，至少包含 40 个成对情景，其中阈值是从试点研究的自助法宽度中选取的。 两个分支在数据收集前均已拟定：一种是能够通过最严格层级检验的缺口；另一种是随着参照物收紧而向零值衰减的缺口，这意味着试点研究中的缺口只是参照物噪声。

paragraphs.en: The binary readout is the majority-vote gap of Section 2 . Because every rollout saved the full next-token distribution at its decision position, a continuous readout was pre-registered as a secondary instrument: p D ​ ( s ) p_{D}(s) is the violating option’s normalized probability mass at the action position, averaged over the 32 order-randomized rollouts; p J ​ ( s ) p_{J}(s) the same at the judgment position over the four frames; the continuous gap is g ⁡ ( s ) = p D − p J g(s)=p_{D}-p_{J} . The amendment was committed after the majority readout’s strictest-level result was known to be unresolved and before any saved vector was read, with a coherence check that could have voided the instrument: thresholding p D p_{D} at 0.5 reproduces the majority action on 95.5% of scenarios (bar 95%), and its mean on the screened panel (0.436) matches the rollout-level violating fraction (0.444) within 0.01. The binary readout keeps primacy in every table; the continuous one is reported beside it, instrument named, and no sentence uses “established” without saying which instrument. In the raw frame, where both models are read by log-probability, the continuous statistic is the natural one and the argmax majority is its binary shadow.

sents.zh: 在多数读数的最严格级别结果被确定为未解决之后、且在任何保存的向量被读取之前，该修正案已提交，并进行了可能使该工具无效的连贯性检查：将 p D p_{D} 的阈值设为 0.5 可在 95.5% 的场景中重现多数动作（排除 95% 的情况），其在筛选面板上的平均值（0.436）与展开层面上的违反比例（0.444）在 0.01 范围内一致。

sents.en: The binary readout keeps primacy in every table; the continuous one is reported beside it, instrument named, and no sentence uses “established” without saying which instrument.
sents.zh: 二进制读数在所有表格中均保持首要地位；连续读数则在其旁边报告，并明确标注了工具名称，且没有任何句子在未说明具体工具的情况下使用“已确立”一词。

sents.en: In the raw frame, where both models are read by log-probability, the continuous statistic is the natural one and the argmax majority is its binary shadow.
sents.zh: 在原始帧中，两个模型均通过对数概率进行读取，此时连续统计量是自然的统计量，而 argmax 多数则是其二进制投影。

paragraphs.en: In short. On OLMo-3, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one screened scenario in five (0.19, 0.13 to 0.28), more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed (an excess of 0.10, 0.02 to 0.18), and far below what an explicit operator order produces (0.58); the log-probability readout shows the same picture.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之。 在 OLMo-3 上，模型在大约五分之一的筛选场景中采取了它判断为错误的行动（0.19，范围 0.13 至 0.28），这一频率高于在没有压力的相同场景中的情况（超出 0.10，范围 0.02 至 0.18），也远低于显式操作指令所产生的频率（0.58）；对数概率的读数也显示出同样的情况。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 is the paper’s calibration figure and Figure 2 its data figure. On the screened panel of record (136 scenarios, 126 with a defined majority gap) the binary gap is 0.19 (95% CI 0.13 to 0.28), the pressure-removed null 0.10 (0.06 to 0.17), and the known-gap band 0.58 (0.51 to 0.65). The paired excess of the measurement over the null is 0.10 (0.02 to 0.18) on 100 scenarios, and the band sits 0.38 (0.24 to 0.48) above the measurement, so the observed rate is neither frame change alone nor instruction-following saturation. On the continuous readout the same rungs read 0.12 (null), 0.18 (measurement), and 0.60 (band), with a paired excess of 0.054 (0.021 to 0.086) on 136 scenarios; the floor, the unsigned shift of the judgment mass under paraphrase, is 0.14. Mass on the violating option is 0.44 when acting and 0.26 when judging. On the twins, with the incentive removed, it is 0.28 and 0.16: even with nothing at stake the immediate action puts more mass on the violating option than the deliberated judgment does, which is the deliberation asymmetry named in Section 3 , and the incentive adds 0.05 to that difference.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 是论文中的校准图，图 2 是其数据图。 在筛选后的记录面板上（136 个场景，其中 126 个具有明确的多数差距），二元差距为 0.19（95% CI 0.13 至 0.28），压力移除后的零值为 0.10（0.06 至 0.17），已知差距带为 0.58（0.51 至 0.65）。 在 100 个场景中，测量值相对于零值的成对超额为 0.10（0.02 至 0.18），而该差距带位于测量值之上 0.38（0.24 至 0.48），因此观测到的比率既不是单独框架变化，也不是指令遵循的饱和状态。 在连续读出中，相同的层级读数分别为 0.12（零值）、0.18（测量值）和 0.60（差距带），在 136 个场景中的成对超额为 0.054（0.021 至 0.086）；基线，即重述条件下判断质量量的无符号偏移，为 0.14。 在执行时，违反选项的质量为 0.44；在判断时则为 0.26。 在双胞胎实验中移除激励后，该数值分别为 0.28 和 0.16：即使没有任何利害关系，即时行动赋予违反选项的质量仍高于经过深思熟虑的判断，这就是第 3 节中提到的审议不对称性，而激励则使这一差异增加了 0.05。

paragraphs.en: Two second derivations. At the rollout level, on screened scenarios whose stable judgment named a non-violating option, the model takes the violating action on 0.38 of rollouts; a majority-rule rate of 0.19 from per-scenario fractions averaging 0.38 is what a mixed panel predicts. Across instruments, the binary excess predicted from the continuous values (the net fraction of paired scenarios whose acting mass crosses 0.5 between the twin and the primary) is 0.14 (0.07 to 0.22) on 88 scenarios, against the observed 0.10 (0.03 to 0.17) on the same scenarios; 20 scenarios cross upward and one crosses downward. The two instruments agree on sign and size, and the majority readout is, as expected, the noisier of the two.
paragraphs.zh: 两次二次推导。 在展开层面上，对于经过筛选且稳定判断指出非违规选项的场景，模型在 0.38 的展开中采取了违规行动；混合专家组预测的多数规则率为 0.19，该率值由各场景 0.38 的平均分数计算得出。 跨不同工具而言，根据连续值预测的二元超额（即成对场景中，其作用质量在孪生模型与主模型之间跨越 0.5 的净比例）为 0.14（范围 0.07 至 0.22），涉及 88 个场景；而同一场景中的观测值为 0.10（范围 0.03 至 0.17）；其中 20 个场景向上跨越，1 个场景向下跨越。 两种工具在符号和量级上保持一致，且多数读出的结果如预期般是两者中噪声更大的一个。

paragraphs.en: The floor and the null are one quantity in two units. The binary floor is an agreement rate (the greedy judgment reproduces itself on a paraphrased frame on 0.70 of scenarios by option, 0.80 by the violating versus non-violating binary), not a gap rate; the pressure-removed null is what that re-elicitation noise and the frame change together produce in gap units, 0.10. On the continuous instrument the floor (0.14) is an unsigned noise scale and the excess (0.054) a signed paired difference against a twin that shares the judgment noise; the two are on different footings and are not compared.
paragraphs.zh: 地板与空值是两个单位中的同一数量。 二进制地板是一种协议率（贪婪判断在 0.70 的场景中通过选项在改写框架上自我复制，在违反与不违反的二进制中为 0.80），而非差距率；压力消除后的空值则是重新激发噪声与框架变化共同在差距单位中产生的结果，即 0.10。 在连续仪器上，地板（0.14）是一个无符号的噪声标度，而超出部分（0.054）则是一个有符号的配对差异，相对于一个共享判断噪声的双胞胎；两者处于不同的基础之上，且互不比较。

paragraphs.en: What the excess is and is not. The absolute rate (0.19 on a three-option forced choice with a neutral option counted as non-violating) is not interpretable alone; the number the paper uses is the paired excess over twins that hold the same options and the same neutral tag with the incentive deleted. Table 4 names the known biases and their directions.
paragraphs.zh: 这种超出部分是什么，以及它不是什么。 绝对比率（在包含一个中性选项的三选一强制选择中，该中性选项被视为不违反原则，比率为 0.19）单独来看并无意义；论文中使用的数字是，在删除激励因素后，与那些拥有相同选项和相同中性标签的双胞胎相比所出现的成对超出值。 表 4 列出了已知的偏差及其方向。

paragraphs.en: A self-referenced gap can be manufactured by a noisy reference, and the floor says the reference is noisy: the greedy judgment changes under paraphrase on 30% of scenarios by option and 20% on the violating versus non-violating binary, and 74 of 208 gate-family primaries fail the sampled-stability rule, 58 of them real consistent-to-violating flips rather than splits between a consistent and a neutral option. This was the rival reading the pilot could not separate (its paraphrase-stable subset halved the rate at 18 scenarios), and the strictness ladder of Section 3 is the instrument built to separate it.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自我参照的缺口可以通过有噪声的参照物制造出来，而底层说明该参照物存在噪声：在 30% 的场景中，基于选项的贪心判断因改写而改变；在违反与不违反的二元对比中，这一比例为 20%；此外，在 208 个门族初级单元中，有 74 个未能通过采样稳定性规则，其中 58 个是真正的从一致到违反的翻转，而非在一致选项与中性选项之间的分裂。 这正是飞行员无法区分的对立解读（其改写稳定的子集将这一比率在 18 个场景中减半），而第 3 节中的严格性阶梯正是为此构建的区分工具。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 gives the answer, and it differs by instrument in an informative way. On the binary readout the excess is 0.10 (0.02 to 0.18) at L0, 0.11 (0.02 to 0.19) at L1, and 0.05 ( − 0.02 -0.02 to 0.19) at L2 with 43 paired scenarios: the gap survives a paraphrase-majority reference and is not resolved against the all-frames-agree reference. On the continuous readout the excess is 0.054 (0.021 to 0.086), 0.063 (0.030 to 0.096), and 0.079 (0.029 to 0.128) with 67 scenarios: it excludes zero at every level and grows with strictness. Read together, the binary shortfall at L2 is the majority rule discarding information at 43 pairs, not the gap shrinking under a stricter reference. The sentences of record, both instruments named: against the strictest judgment reference the gap exceeds the pressure-removed null by 0.079 (0.029 to 0.128) on the log-prob readout; on the majority readout at 43 paired scenarios it is not resolved (0.05, − 0.02 -0.02 to 0.19). A pilot-era robustness cell agrees: restricting to scenarios whose greedy judgment survives the first paraphrase leaves the binary gap at 0.17 (0.11 to 0.28; 90 scenarios) against 0.19 on the full screened panel, where the 96-scenario pilot had halved it at 18 scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 图3给出了答案，不同仪器的结果呈现出具有信息价值的差异。 在二元读出中，L0处的超额值为0.10（0.02至0.18），L1处为0.11（0.02至0.19），L2处为0.05（−0.02至0.19），共涉及43个成对场景：该差异在重述-多数参考下仍然存在，且在与所有框架一致参考的对比中未能被消除。 在连续读出中，超额值分别为0.054（0.021至0.086）、0.063（0.030至0.096）和0.079（0.029至0.128），共涉及67个场景：它在每个层级都排除了零值，并随着严格程度的提高而增大。 综合来看，L2处的二元短缺反映了多数规则在43对场景中丢弃了信息，而非差异在更严格的参考下缩小。 记录中的句子提到了两种仪器名称：在最严格的判断参考下，该差异在概率对数读出中比压力移除的零值高出0.079（0.029至0.128）；而在43个成对场景的多数读出中，该差异未能被消除（0.05，−0.02至0.19）。 一个试点阶段的稳健性分析单元也证实了这一点：仅保留其贪婪判断能通过首次重述的场景后，二元差异在完整筛选面板中为0.17（0.11至0.28；90个场景），而在包含96个场景的试点阶段，该差异在18个场景下已减半。

sents.en: The sentences of record, both instruments named: against the strictest judgment reference the gap exceeds the pressure-removed null by 0.079 (0.029 to 0.128) on the log-prob readout; on the majority readout at 43 paired scenarios it is not resolved (0.05, − 0.02 -0.02 to 0.19).
sents.zh: 记录中的句子提到了两种仪器名称：在最严格的判断参考下，该差异在概率对数读出中比压力移除的零值高出0.079（0.029至0.128）；而在43个成对场景的多数读出中，该差异未能被消除（0.05，−0.02至0.19）。

sents.en: A pilot-era robustness cell agrees: restricting to scenarios whose greedy judgment survives the first paraphrase leaves the binary gap at 0.17 (0.11 to 0.28; 90 scenarios) against 0.19 on the full screened panel, where the 96-scenario pilot had halved it at 18 scenarios.
sents.zh: 一个试点阶段的稳健性分析单元也证实了这一点：仅保留其贪婪判断能通过首次重述的场景后，二元差异在完整筛选面板中为0.17（0.11至0.28；90个场景），而在包含96个场景的试点阶段，该差异在18个场景下已减半。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows why the excess grows. Tightening the reference selects scenarios the model judges decisively, so the judging mass on the violating option falls from 0.26 to 0.18; the acting mass barely moves (0.44 to 0.41), so the gap opens. The twins’ judging mass falls too, from 0.16 to 0.11, but by less, so the paired excess rises. The rival that the strictest level selects the most tempting scenarios is checked by the acting mass itself, which does not rise from L0 to L2. The gap is largest where the model’s judgment is least ambiguous, which is the opposite of what reference noise would produce, and the reference-noise rival is separated on the continuous instrument at every level.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 说明了超额值为何会增长。 收紧参考标准会筛选出模型能明确判断的情景，因此对违规选项的判断质量从 0.26 降至 0.18；行动质量几乎未变（从 0.44 变为 0.41），于是差距扩大。 双胞胎的判断质量也下降了，从 0.16 降至 0.11，但降幅较小，因此成对的超额值上升。 最严格标准所筛选出的、最具诱惑力的情景，其竞争者会受到行动质量本身的制约，而行动质量从 L0 到 L2 并未上升。 在模型判断最不模糊的地方，差距最大，这与参考噪声所产生的效果相反；并且在连续工具上，参考噪声的竞争者在每个层级都被区分开来。

paragraphs.en: What the ladder also shows is that the stated judgment of a 7B instruct model on these scenarios is often not decisive: half of the screened scenarios do not survive the all-frames-agree reference. That is a finding about the reference, and a reason to build the next panel’s scenarios to be decisive by construction, so that the strictest level keeps its power on the majority readout as well.
paragraphs.zh: 该阶梯图还表明，7B指令模型对这些场景的明确判断往往并不具有决定性：经过筛选的场景中有一半未能通过“所有帧一致”参考标准的检验。 这一发现涉及参考标准本身，也是构建下一组场景时必须确保其具有决定性的原因，这样最严格的标准才能对多数结果保持约束力。

paragraphs.en: The pre-registration named three shapes. Branch A , the action channel reads harm the way refusal does: the gap is present and is smallest on F5, the family where the violating option harms a non-present party. Branch B , no detectable gap above the ladder’s bar. Branch C , a gap with no family structure. Figure 4 is Branch C. On the binary readout the family rates are F1 0.22 (0.08 to 0.34; 41 scenarios), F3 0.14 (0.03 to 0.29; 37), F4 0.21 (0.08 to 0.39; 24), and F5 0.22 (0.06 to 0.41; 18); the pre-registered contrast, F1+F3+F4 minus F5, is − 0.04 -0.04 ( − 0.27 -0.27 to 0.16). The continuous readout orders them F1 0.21, F4 0.17, F5 0.16, F3 0.12, again with F5 not lowest. The family-contrast minimum detectable effect at this power is about 0.40 on the binary readout (the pre-registered contrast’s CI half-width is 0.22), so the finding is bounded: no harm-keyed structure detectable above that. The pilot’s candidate structure (F3 high, F4 low, at six to twelve scenarios per family) did not replicate and is recorded as noise. F2, the sycophancy family, never engaged pressure on this model (6 of 40 screened, 34 with no pressure) and stays an appendix family as pre-registered.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册命名了三种形状。 分支 A 中，动作通道读取伤害的方式与拒绝相同：存在一个差距，且该差距在 F5 处最小，而 F5 正是违规选项损害不存在一方的家族。 分支 B 中，阶梯横杆上方未检测到任何差距。 分支 C 中，存在一个没有家族结构的差距。图 4 即为分支 C。 在二进制读数中，各家族的评分为：F1 0.22（0.08 至 0.34；41 个场景）、F3 0.14（0.03 至 0.29；37 个）、F4 0.21（0.08 至 0.39；24 个）以及 F5 0.22（0.06 至 0.41；18 个）；预注册的对比值（F1+F3+F4 减去 F5）为 −0.04 -0.04（−0.27 -0.27 至 0.16）。 连续读数将它们排序为：F1 0.21、F4 0.17、F5 0.16、F3 0.12，同样地，F5 并非最低。 在此统计功效下，家族对比的最小可检测效应约为 0.40（二进制读数中预注册对比的置信区间半宽为 0.22），因此该发现存在界限：无法检测到高于该值的伤害相关结构。 试点研究中提出的候选结构（F3 高、F4 低，每个家族包含六至十二个场景）未能复现，并被记录为噪声。 F2（谄媚家族）在此模型中从未表现出压力（在 40 个筛选样本中有 6 个存在压力，其余 34 个无压力），并如预注册所设，仍被归类为附录家族。

paragraphs.en: An exploratory read on the continuous instrument. The continuous readout is tighter, and six pairwise family contrasts on it were computed under a labelled amendment ( Appendix A ) as exploratory, not verdict-bearing. One separates: F1 minus F3 is 0.09 (0.02 to 0.16). With six 95% intervals, about one panel in four shows a chance separation, so this is a candidate, entered in the anomaly ledger, not a finding. The same instrument gives each family’s paired excess over its own null: F1 0.08 (0.02 to 0.13), F3 0.02 ( − 0.04 -0.04 to 0.08), F4 0.12 (0.05 to 0.20), and F5 − 0.01 -0.01 ( − 0.09 -0.09 to 0.07). The F5 interval includes both zero and the pooled excess of 0.054 at 21 scenarios, so it neither supports nor excludes the harm-keyed prediction; the cheap discriminator is more F3 and F5 scenarios, and it is priced in Section 11 . One reading of the low F3 excess, that the incentive moves the action only where the prohibited tool is the sole fast route, was tested at no compute cost under a rule fixed in advance: a rater from the other model provider judged the prohibited tool the only fast route in 36 of 40 screened F3 scenarios, and the excess difference between those 36 and the other 4 is − 0.05 -0.05 ( − 0.15 -0.15 to 0.09), not resolved at a detection bar of 0.17. The F3 scenarios almost never offer a quick permitted alternative, so that is not why their excess is small.
paragraphs.zh: 对连续测量仪器进行初步解读。 连续读数更为精确，根据一项标记修订（附录 A），对其计算了六个成对的家庭对比，这些对比属于探索性分析，而非具有裁决意义的结果。 其中一个差异为：F1 减去 F3 等于 0.09（0.02 至 0.16）。 在六个 95% 置信区间中，大约四分之一的面板显示出偶然分离，因此这是一个候选项，已记录于异常日志中，而非一项发现。 同一仪器给出了每个家庭相对于自身零假设的成对超额值：F1 为 0.08（0.02 至 0.13），F3 为 0.02（−0.04 至 0.08），F4 为 0.12（0.05 至 0.20），以及 F5 为 −0.01（−0.09 至 0.07）。 F5 的置信区间既包含零，也包含 21 个场景下 0.054 的合并超额值，因此它既不支持也不排除与危害相关的预测；更便宜的判别器更多涉及 F3 和 F5 的场景，其定价见第 11 节。 对 F3 超额值较低的一种解读是：激励仅在禁止工具为唯一快速路径时才会改变行为。这一解读通过一项预先设定的规则进行了无计算成本的检验：来自另一模型提供商的评估员在 40 个经过筛选的 F3 场景中，有 36 次判定禁止工具是唯一快速路径；这 36 个场景与其他 4 个场景之间的超额差异为 −0.05（−0.15 至 0.09），未达到 0.17 的检测阈值。 F3 的场景几乎从不提供快速且被允许的替代方案，因此其超额值较小并非出于这一原因。

paragraphs.en: Pooled by generator the screened rates are 0.15 (0.08 to 0.25; 66 scenarios) for Claude-written and 0.23 (0.14 to 0.38; 60) for GPT-written scenarios on the binary readout, 0.16 and 0.19 on the continuous one: same sign, overlapping, and no family reverses across generator except one.
paragraphs.zh: 由生成器汇总的筛选后比率，在二元读出中，Claude 撰写的场景为 0.15（0.08 至 0.25；66 个场景），GPT 撰写的场景为 0.23（0.14 至 0.38；60 个场景）；在连续读出中，这两个比率分别为 0.16 和 0.19：符号相同、存在重叠，且除一个外，不同生成器之间没有家族反转。

paragraphs.en: On the binary readout F4 (in-group favor versus fair allocation) reverses across generator: Claude-written 0.00 (0.00 to 0.27; 11 scenarios), GPT-written 0.38 (0.15 to 0.62; 13), each CI excluding the other’s point ( Figure 5 ). By the pre-registered rule this is an anomaly, reported per generator and excluded from the pooled verdict, and it failed the full gate’s reversal clause by the letter. Three legs then ran, none of them on a GPU. The cross-rated external labels showed no asymmetry (every F4 primary’s label agreed with the construction on both halves). A paraphrase-swap cell, in which each generator’s F4 scenarios were paraphrased by the other with the options held fixed, moved the acting mass slightly toward the paraphraser in both directions ( − 0.03 -0.03 and − 0.07 -0.07 in mass, both CIs including zero) and separated nothing at 20 pairs per side. And a blind read by the author of the 24 screened F4 scenarios, labels and origins hidden, agreed with the construction label on 10 of 11 Claude-written and 11 of 13 GPT-written items, with violating picks 1 and 2, forced picks (“none acceptable”) 2 and 3, and ties 9 and 5. On the continuous readout the two halves are 0.13 (0.01 to 0.22) and 0.22 (0.11 to 0.34), overlapping, and the decomposition puts the difference on both sides (acting mass 0.35 versus 0.41, judging mass 0.20 versus 0.17).
paragraphs.zh: 在二元读数 F4（群体内偏袒与公平分配）中，结果因生成器而异：Claude 生成的数据为 0.00（范围 0.00 至 0.27；11 个场景），GPT 生成的数据为 0.38（范围 0.15 至 0.62；13 个场景），且每个置信区间都不包含另一方的数值（图 5）。 根据预先登记的规则，这属于异常现象，因此按生成器分别报告并从合并结论中排除，而且它严格未能通过完整检验中的反转条款。 随后运行了三个部分，但没有任何一个使用 GPU。 跨评级的外部标签未显示任何不对称性（每个 F4 主要项的标签与两个半部分上的构建结果均一致）。 在一个改写替换单元格中，每个生成器的 F4 场景由另一方进行改写，而选项保持不变；改写结果使作用质量在两个方向上略微偏向改写者（质量分别为 −0.03 至 −0.03 和 −0.07 至 −0.07，两个置信区间均包含零），但在每侧 20 对数据中未产生任何分离。 此外，作者对 24 个经过筛选的 F4 场景进行了盲测（标签和来源均被隐藏），结果与构建标签在 Claude 生成的 11 项中有 10 项一致，在 GPT 生成的 13 项中有 11 项一致；不符合项为第 1 和第 2 项，强制选择项（“无一可接受”）为第 2 和第 3 项，平局项为第 9 和第 5 项。 在连续读数中，两个半部分的结果分别为 0.13（范围 0.01 至 0.22）和 0.22（范围 0.11 至 0.34），存在重叠；分解结果显示差异存在于两侧（作用质量为 0.35 对 0.41，判断质量为 0.20 对 0.17）。

sents.en: A paraphrase-swap cell, in which each generator’s F4 scenarios were paraphrased by the other with the options held fixed, moved the acting mass slightly toward the paraphraser in both directions ( − 0.03 -0.03 and − 0.07 -0.07 in mass, both CIs including zero) and separated nothing at 20 pairs per side.
sents.zh: 在一个改写替换单元格中，每个生成器的 F4 场景由另一方进行改写，而选项保持不变；改写结果使作用质量在两个方向上略微偏向改写者（质量分别为 −0.03 至 −0.03 和 −0.07 至 −0.07，两个置信区间均包含零），但在每侧 20 对数据中未产生任何分离。

sents.en: And a blind read by the author of the 24 screened F4 scenarios, labels and origins hidden, agreed with the construction label on 10 of 11 Claude-written and 11 of 13 GPT-written items, with violating picks 1 and 2, forced picks (“none acceptable”) 2 and 3, and ties 9 and 5.
sents.zh: 此外，作者对 24 个经过筛选的 F4 场景进行了盲测（标签和来源均被隐藏），结果与构建标签在 Claude 生成的 11 项中有 10 项一致，在 GPT 生成的 13 项中有 11 项一致；不符合项为第 1 和第 2 项，强制选择项（“无一可接受”）为第 2 和第 3 项，平局项为第 9 和第 5 项。

sents.en: On the continuous readout the two halves are 0.13 (0.01 to 0.22) and 0.22 (0.11 to 0.34), overlapping, and the decomposition puts the difference on both sides (acting mass 0.35 versus 0.41, judging mass 0.20 versus 0.17).
sents.zh: 在连续读数中，两个半部分的结果分别为 0.13（范围 0.01 至 0.22）和 0.22（范围 0.11 至 0.34），存在重叠；分解结果显示差异存在于两侧（作用质量为 0.35 对 0.41，判断质量为 0.20 对 0.17）。

paragraphs.en: In short. On OLMo-3 the gap shows up before and after post-training. In the base model, which can only be read as plain text completion, the part the incentive adds is 0.017 (0.012 to 0.022); we report this as a description, because that format misreads chat models. In the aligned model, read in its own chat format on all 586 scenarios, the gap is already present after supervised fine-tuning (0.015, 0.007 to 0.023), and no later stage makes it detectably larger (0.014 after DPO and 0.018 after RL; detection bars of 0.008 and 0.005 for the two steps, with the RL step’s +0.004 at its bar; Figure 6 ), while the same test registers a large gap on the final model when its operator orders the violation (0.497, 0.468 to 0.525). What post-training does change is the model’s default lean when it acts: preference optimization nudges it toward the advantageous option even when nothing is at stake (+0.011, 0.007 to 0.016).
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之。 在 OLMo-3 上，这一差距在预训练前后都显现出来。 在基础模型中（只能被解读为纯文本补全），激励机制所增加的部分为 0.017（0.012 至 0.022）；我们将其作为描述性信息报告，因为这种格式会错误地解读聊天模型。 在对齐模型中，通过其自身的聊天格式在所有 586 个场景中进行解读，这一差距在监督微调阶段就已经存在（0.015，0.007 至 0.023），且后续任何阶段都没有使其明显增大（DPO 后为 0.014，RL 后为 0.018；两个步骤的检测阈值分别为 0.008 和 0.005，其中 RL 步骤的 +0.004 恰好处于其阈值范围内；参见图 6），而当操作者命令该模型违反规则时，同一测试在最终模型上记录下了巨大的差距（0.497，0.468 至 0.525）。 预训练阶段所改变的是模型在执行操作时的默认倾向：偏好优化会使其更倾向于选择有利的选项，即使此时没有任何利害关系（+0.011，0.007 至 0.016）。

paragraphs.en: Base-versus-instruct is the question of origin: a gap present in base weights is inherited from pretraining; a gap absent in base and present in instruct would point to post-training. A base model has no chat template, so the only frame both models share is a raw completion frame (scenario, option list, fixed prefix ending before the option token; the readout is the option-letter probability mass, eight option orders). Each model’s pressure-removed twins give it a matched null in the same frame, and the quantity compared is the pressure-attributable excess E E : the paired difference between the acting-versus-judging mass gap on a scenario and on its twin. The verdict rules were fixed in dated amendments before the numbers below were computed ( Appendix A ; tables in Appendix D ). The instruct model is also read under its own chat template, with a letter-only judgment so that acting and judging differ only in role and frame. That second readout changed what this section can claim, and we report the change as a result.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型与指令模型之间的差异源于何处：基础权重中存在的差距源自预训练；而基础模型中不存在但在指令模型中存在的差距则表明差异出现在后训练阶段。 基础模型没有聊天模板，因此两个模型唯一共享的框架是原始补全框架（场景、选项列表、在选项标记前结束的稳定前缀；读出的结果是选项字母的概率质量，共八种选项顺序）。 每个模型的解压孪生模型都在同一框架中为其提供了一个匹配的零值，而比较的量则是可归因于压力的超额值 E E：即某个场景与其孪生模型在执行与判断之间的质量差距的配对差异。 判决规则在计算以下数值之前已通过旧版修正案确定（附录 A；附录 D 中的表格）。 指令模型也按照其自身的聊天模板进行读取，且仅以字母形式作出判断，因此执行与判断仅在角色和框架上存在差异。 这种第二次读出的变化改变了本部分可以得出的结论，因此我们在此报告了这一变化。

paragraphs.en: Present in base. In the raw frame the base model puts more mass on the violating option when acting than when judging, 0.041 (0.034 to 0.049) on 359 scenarios, and 0.024 (0.017 to 0.030) on the pressure-removed twins: a second-person frame alone moves the base model toward the violating option. The pressure-attributable excess, 0.017 (0.012 to 0.022), excludes zero. The binary shadow of the same quantity does not resolve (0.024, − 0.021 -0.021 to 0.065), which is the majority rule on a small mass effect, not a disagreement in sign. This cell is descriptive. The raw frame is the only frame a base model has, and the pre-registered bridge test shows it already misreads the first templated checkpoint: at rest, SFT’s gap is − 0.019 -0.019 ( − 0.035 -0.035 to − 0.003 -0.003 ) in the raw frame and + 0.033 +0.033 (0.021 to 0.045) under its template, a difference of − 0.052 -0.052 ( − 0.070 -0.070 to − 0.034 -0.034 ) on 310 scenarios. We therefore report the base number as the raw frame’s reading of the base model, not as a validated comparison with the aligned model.
paragraphs.zh: 存在于基础模型中。 在原始框架中，基础模型在执行时比在判断时更倾向于支持违规选项：在359个场景中，该倾向为0.041（0.034至0.049）；在压力移除的双胞胎模型中，该倾向为0.024（0.017至0.030）。仅第二人称框架就将基础模型向违规选项推动。 可归因于压力的超额值为0.017（0.012至0.022），且排除了零值的可能性。 同一数值的二元阴影未能明确解决（0.024，−0.021至0.065），这反映的是小质量效应下的多数规则，而非符号上的分歧。 此单元格具有描述性。 原始框架是基础模型唯一拥有的框架，而预先注册的桥接测试表明，它已经错误解读了第一个模板化检查点：在静止状态下，SFT在原始框架中的差距为−0.019（−0.035至−0.003），而在其模板下则为+0.033（0.021至0.045）；在310个场景中，两者差异为−0.052（−0.070至−0.034）。 因此，我们将基础数值报告为原始框架对基础模型的解读，而非与对齐模型经过验证的比较结果。

paragraphs.en: Survives post-training, under the model’s own template. Read under its chat template on the 136 screened scenarios, the instruct model’s acting-versus-judging gap is 0.055 (0.034 to 0.076) with nothing at stake and 0.084 (0.059 to 0.110) under pressure; the pressure-attributable excess is 0.030 (0.006 to 0.053). The gap has the base model’s sign at rest and under pressure, and the part of it the incentive adds does not disappear with alignment. The screened set was selected on this model’s own chat actions, which inflates the raw gap; the twin-differenced excess is less exposed to that selection, and it is the number we lean on. Framing the same prompts as an internal safety evaluation lowers the at-rest gap by about 0.01 (0.010, 0.001 to 0.021 on the 208 raw-engaged scenarios; not resolved on the 136) and does not detectably move the excess ( − 0.008 -0.008 , − 0.026 -0.026 to 0.012).
paragraphs.zh: 在训练后，模型能根据自身的模板继续运行。 在其聊天模板下，针对 136 个筛选后的场景进行阅读时，指令模型在“行动”与“判断”之间的差距为 0.055（0.034 至 0.076），在无利害关系时为 0.084（0.059 至 0.110）；其中可归因于压力的额外差距为 0.030（0.006 至 0.053）。 该差距在静态和压力状态下均与基础模型的方向一致，而激励因素所增加的部分并不会因对齐而消失。 筛选集是基于该模型自身的聊天行为选择的，这夸大了原始差距；通过双重差分法得到的额外差距受这种选择的影响较小，也是我们依赖的数值。 将相同的提示词框架为内部安全评估，可使静态状态下的差距降低约 0.01（在 208 个原始参与场景中为 0.010，范围是 0.001 至 0.021；在 136 个场景中尚未得出明确结论），且不会对额外差距产生可检测的影响（−0.008 ± 0.008，范围是 −0.026 至 0.012）。

paragraphs.en: A format check that changed a reading. In the raw frame the instruct model’s no-pressure gap is − 0.038 -0.038 ( − 0.059 -0.059 to − 0.015 -0.015 ): with nothing at stake it looks more cautious acting than judging, which would read as post-training lowering the baseline while raising the action’s sensitivity to the incentive. A pre-registered cell separates an agent-frame caution installed by post-training from a raw-frame artifact, with both branches fixed in advance. Under the template the sign is positive (+0.055, 0.034 to 0.076), and the artifact branch holds. The raw frame also exaggerates how much sharper the instruct model’s agent-frame output is than its judge-frame output (a ratio of 1.79 raw against 1.07 under the template). paragraphs.en: What remains of the raw-frame comparison. On the 192 scenarios both models engage in the raw frame, the instruct model’s excess is 0.046 against base’s 0.018 (paired difference 0.028, 0.007 to 0.049; MDE 0.030), and the pre-registered rule names that branch widened . We report the number under the rule’s word and do not rest a claim on it. The instruct side of that comparison is a raw-frame cell carrying the format effect above; on the log-odds scale the difference survives, but divided by each model’s own output scale it does not resolve (0.12, − 0.02 -0.02 to 0.26), and the scale factor is itself partly a raw-frame property of the instruct model. The comparison that is template-valid on every side runs across post-training stages under one template. On the 136 screened scenarios the pressure-attributable excess is 0.021 (0.006 to 0.036) after SFT, 0.022 (0.002 to 0.043) after DPO and 0.030 (0.006 to 0.053) after RLVR; the DPO and RL steps are 0.001 ( − 0.012 -0.012 to 0.014) and 0.007 ( − 0.001 -0.001 to 0.016). On this screened set neither step’s interval excludes zero (bars 0.019 for the DPO step and 0.012 for the RL step, n = 136 n=136 ); the stage contrast of record is the unscreened set below.
paragraphs.zh: 原始帧比较的剩余部分。 在两个模型均参与原始帧处理的 192 个场景中，指令模型的优势为 0.046，而基础模型为 0.018（配对差异为 0.028，置信区间为 0.007 至 0.049；MDE 为 0.030），且预先注册的规则名称在此分支中扩大了差异。 我们在规则对应的词语下方报告该数值，但不对此提出任何主张。 该比较的指令模型一侧是一个包含上述格式效应的原始帧单元格；在对数几率尺度上，这种差异仍然存在，但若除以每个模型自身的输出尺度，则差异不再显著（0.12，−0.02 至 −0.02 到 0.26），且该尺度因子本身部分属于指令模型的原始帧特性。 在所有方面均符合模板有效性的比较，是在单一模板下贯穿整个后训练阶段进行的。 在筛选出的 136 个场景中，可归因于压力的优势在 SFT 后为 0.021（0.006 至 0.036），在 DPO 后为 0.022（0.002 至 0.043），在 RLVR 后为 0.030（0.006 至 0.053）；DPO 和 RL 步骤的差异分别为 0.001（−0.012 至 −0.012 到 0.014）和 0.007（−0.001 至 −0.001 到 0.016）。 在这一筛选后的数据集中，两个步骤的置信区间均未排除零（DPO 步骤的置信区间为 0.019，RL 步骤为 0.012，n = 136）；记录中的阶段对比则基于下方的未筛选数据集。

paragraphs.en: What post-training does change. Read on a set screened by no model’s actions (all 586 union scenarios, each checkpoint under its own template), the acting frame’s lean toward the violating option at rest grows at the DPO step: 0.021 after SFT, 0.033 after DPO and 0.039 after RLVR. The DPO step, +0.011 (0.007 to 0.016), survives division by each checkpoint’s output scale (+0.058, 0.027 to 0.090), so it is not the sharpening that post-training also brings. The RL step is positive on the probability scale (+0.006, 0.003 to 0.009) but not per unit of output scale (+0.018, − 0.001 -0.001 to 0.037), and reads as that sharpening. No step enlarges the pressure-attributable part on either readout (positive control on the final checkpoint: known-gap band 0.497, 0.468 to 0.525; the cell was not run on the SFT and DPO checkpoints). On the probability scale the DPO step does not move it ( − 0.001 -0.001 , − 0.006 -0.006 to 0.005; bar 0.008), and per unit of output scale it falls ( − 0.039 -0.039 , − 0.069 -0.069 to − 0.008 -0.008 ), because DPO sharpens the output without adding pull. The RL step reads +0.004 on the probability scale (0.000 to 0.008; bar 0.005), at the bar, with every known bias favoring a positive step and the same sign as the screened set; on the primary per-unit-of-output-scale readout it is +0.005 ( − 0.016 -0.016 to 0.026; bar 0.030). Log-odds also excludes zero, so baseline compression is ruled out and the remaining rival is the output sharpening the RL step also brings. Preference optimization makes the model, placed as the actor, lean further toward the locally advantageous option than it does as a judge, without enlarging how much the incentive adds on either readout. That is the opposite direction from the raw frame’s at-rest reading, and it replicates on a second DPO recipe ( Section 8 ); which part of the DPO stage produces it is left to a recipe ablation on one base.
paragraphs.zh: 后训练阶段会发生怎样的变化。 在一个不受任何模型行为影响的数据集上（全部586种联合场景，每个检查点均使用其自身模板）进行读取时，行为框架在静止状态下倾向于违规选项的倾向在DPO步骤中增强：SFT后为0.021，DPO后为0.033，RLVR后为0.039。 DPO步骤带来的+0.011（从0.007到0.016）在除以每个检查点的输出尺度后仍然存在（+0.058，从0.027到0.090），因此这并非后训练阶段所引入的增强效应。 RL步骤在概率尺度上是正的（+0.006，从0.003到0.009），但按输出尺度单位计算则不然（+0.018，−0.001至−0.001到0.037），因此这表现为增强效应。 没有任何步骤扩大可归因于压力的部分，无论在哪种读取结果中（最终检查点的正向控制：已知差距区间为0.497，从0.468到0.525；该单元格未在SFT和DPO检查点上运行）。 在概率尺度上，DPO步骤并未改变该值（−0.001至−0.001，−0.006至−0.006到0.005；条状图0.008），而按输出尺度单位计算则有所下降（−0.039至−0.039，−0.069至−0.069到−0.008至−0.008），因为DPO增强了输出但未增加吸引力。 RL步骤在概率尺度上显示为+0.004（从0.000到0.008；条状图0.005），与条状图一致，所有已知偏差均支持正向步骤，且符号与筛选数据集相同；在主要的按输出尺度单位计算的读取结果中，该值为+0.005（−0.016至−0.016到0.026；条状图0.030）。 对数赔率也排除了零值，因此基线压缩被排除，剩下的竞争解释是RL步骤所引入的输出增强效应。 偏好优化使模型作为执行者时比作为评判者时更倾向于局部有利的选项，但并未扩大激励在任一读取结果中的影响程度。 这与原始框架的静止状态读数方向相反，并且这一现象在第二种DPO方案（第8节）中得以复现；DPO阶段的哪一部分产生了这一效应，仍有待通过基于单一基线的方案消融分析来明确。

paragraphs.en: In short. We read four aligned models the same way, after first checking with a positive control that the test can see a large gap on each (0.50 to 0.62). Two carry the gap: OLMo-3 (0.018) and Meta’s Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (0.028). On the whole panel two show none the test can see: Ai2’s Tulu 3 (0.001, nothing above about 0.01) and Qwen2.5 ( − 0.008 -0.008 , nothing above about 0.02). Read only on each model’s own most-pressuring scenarios, all four show an excess (Tulu 3 0.05, Qwen2.5 0.19), but that screen favors a positive value by construction; against the same screen applied to the pressure-removed twins, OLMo-3 (0.073) and Llama-3.1 (0.143) keep a gap, Tulu 3 does not ( − 0.004 -0.004 ), and Qwen2.5 is unresolved (0.083, − 0.028 -0.028 to 0.195; n = 47 n=47 , bar about 0.16). So Tulu 3 shows none on either read, and Qwen2.5 shows none on the whole panel and is unresolved on its own screened scenarios. The clearest comparison is Meta’s and Tulu 3’s: both start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta’s carries the gap. Tulu 3 shows none already after its first stage, so whatever differs happens early in its recipe.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之。 在首先通过一个阳性对照确认测试能在每个模型上观察到明显差距（0.50至0.62）之后，我们以相同方式读取了四个对齐模型。 有两个模型存在这种差距：OLMo-3（0.018）和Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（0.028）。 在整个面板中，有两个模型未显示任何测试可观察到的差距：Ai2的Tulu 3（0.001，在约0.01以上没有任何值）和Qwen2.5（−0.008至−0.008，在约0.02以上没有任何值）。 仅在每个模型自身的最大压力场景下读取时，四个模型都显示出超额值（Tulu 3为0.05，Qwen2.5为0.19），但该筛选机制本身倾向于呈现正值；若将同一筛选机制应用于压力移除的孪生模型，OLMo-3（0.073）和Llama-3.1（0.143）仍保持差距，Tulu 3则没有（−0.004至−0.004），而Qwen2.5的结果未明确（0.083，从−0.028至−0.028到0.195；n = 47，柱状图约0.16）。 因此，Tulu 3在两种读取方式下均未显示任何差距，而Qwen2.5在整个面板中未显示差距，且在其自身筛选后的场景中也结果未明确。 最清晰的对比是Meta模型与Tulu 3：两者均从相同的Llama-3.1权重开始，但只有Meta的模型存在这种差距。 Tulu 3在第一个阶段之后就已未显示任何差距，因此造成差异的因素必然出现在其构建流程的早期阶段。

sents.en: Read only on each model’s own most-pressuring scenarios, all four show an excess (Tulu 3 0.05, Qwen2.5 0.19), but that screen favors a positive value by construction; against the same screen applied to the pressure-removed twins, OLMo-3 (0.073) and Llama-3.1 (0.143) keep a gap, Tulu 3 does not ( − 0.004 -0.004 ), and Qwen2.5 is unresolved (0.083, − 0.028 -0.028 to 0.195; n = 47 n=47 , bar about 0.16).

sents.en: So Tulu 3 shows none on either read, and Qwen2.5 shows none on the whole panel and is unresolved on its own screened scenarios.
sents.zh: 因此，Tulu 3在两种读取方式下均未显示任何差距，而Qwen2.5在整个面板中未显示差距，且在其自身筛选后的场景中也结果未明确。

sents.en: The clearest comparison is Meta’s and Tulu 3’s: both start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta’s carries the gap.
sents.zh: 最清晰的对比是Meta模型与Tulu 3：两者均从相同的Llama-3.1权重开始，但只有Meta的模型存在这种差距。

sents.en: Tulu 3 shows none already after its first stage, so whatever differs happens early in its recipe.
sents.zh: Tulu 3在第一个阶段之后就已未显示任何差距，因此造成差异的因素必然出现在其构建流程的早期阶段。

paragraphs.en: A gap measured on one model could be a property of that model, of its lineage, or of the panel. We read four instruct models with the same instrument under their own chat templates: OLMo-3-7B-Instruct ( Team Olmo et al., 2025 ) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Meta’s post-training) ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Tulu 3 (Ai2’s post-training applied to the same Llama-3.1 base, read at its SFT, DPO and final checkpoints) ( Lambert et al., 2024 ) and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) , with the bases of the three lineages in the raw frame. Every judgment and action is the letter-only readout of Section 7 on all 586 union scenarios, which every model engages (option-letter mass above the 0.5 floor on 586 of 586). A null from an instrument that could not have detected a gap is not a finding, so each instruct model first gets a positive control: the known-gap cell, in which the system prompt instructs the violating action. The rule, fixed before the run, reads a model’s null as “instrument not validated” unless the known-gap acting-versus-judging mass difference has a 95% lower bound of at least 0.10.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个模型上测得的差异可能是该模型本身、其谱系或评估面板的特性。 我们使用相同的工具，在其各自的聊天模板下对四个指令模型进行了测试：OLMo-3-7B-Instruct（Team Olmo 等，2025）、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（Meta 的后训练模型）（Grattafiori 等，2024）、Tulu 3（Ai2 将后训练方法应用于相同的 Llama-3.1 基础模型，并在其 SFT、DPO 和最终检查点上进行测试）（Lambert 等，2024），以及 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen 等，2024），其中这三个谱系的基础模型均包含在原始框架中。 每一项判断和行动都是对第 7 节中全部 586 种联合场景的纯字母形式输出，每个模型都参与了这些场景（在所有 586 个场景中，选项字母的质量均高于 0.5 的阈值）。 如果某个工具未能检测到差异而返回空值，则这并不构成一项发现，因此每个指令模型首先会接受一个阳性对照：已知差异单元格，其中系统提示会引导模型执行违规操作。 该规则在运行前已固定：除非已知差异场景下“执行”与“判断”的质量差异的 95% 置信下限至少为 0.10，否则模型的空值将被解读为“工具未通过验证”。

paragraphs.en: The OLMo-3 value in Table 7 (0.018) is the whole-panel excess on the letter-only readout. It is not the 0.030 of Section 7 , which is the same readout on the 136 scenarios screened on this model’s own actions, nor the one-in-five of Section 4 (0.19), which is a majority-vote rate over sampled rollouts on those scenarios; the three answer different questions about one gap. The positive control likewise appears as 0.58 (majority readout, Section 4 ), 0.60 (continuous readout) and 0.497 (letter-only, on the 360 union primaries the known-gap cell reads): the same control on three readouts.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 中的 OLMo-3 值（0.018）是仅字母读出的整个面板的超额值。 它并非第 7 节中的 0.030——该值是在本模型自身动作下筛选出的 136 个场景上对相同读出的结果，也非第 4 节中的五分之一（0.19）——该值是在这些场景上对采样展开进行多数投票得出的比率；这三个数值分别回答了关于同一差距的不同问题。 阳性对照同样表现为 0.58（多数读出，第 4 节）、0.60（连续读出）和 0.497（仅字母读出，在已知差距单元格读取的 360 个联合初级数据集上）：这是同一对照在三种读出方式下的结果。

paragraphs.en: The instrument is validated on every model. Told by its operator to take the violating action, each model’s acting frame moves toward it by half a unit of probability or more (0.50 to 0.62; every lower bound at or above 0.47; Figure 7 ), so each readout can register a change of action when one happens.
paragraphs.zh: 该仪器在每一个模型上均经过验证。 在其操作员的指示下采取违规行动时，每个模型的行动框架会向该行动方向移动至少半个概率单位（0.50 至 0.62；所有下限均不低于 0.47；见图 7），因此每次行动变化发生时，每一次读数都能记录到这一变化。

sents.en: The instrument is validated on every model.
sents.zh: 该仪器在每一个模型上均经过验证。

paragraphs.en: Two recipes carry the gap; Tulu 3 shows none on either read; Qwen2.5 shows none on the whole panel. Under their own templates, OLMo-3-Instruct and Meta’s Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct each carry a pressure-attributable excess (0.018 and 0.028, both intervals above zero). Tulu 3 carries none that the instrument detects at any of its three stages (final 0.001, − 0.007 -0.007 to 0.010; not detectable above about 0.01), and neither does Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( − 0.008 -0.008 , − 0.023 -0.023 to 0.009; not detectable above about 0.02). These are whole-panel numbers. On each model’s own screened scenarios (a post-review addition, P1-A11) every model shows an excess, Tulu 3 (0.051, 0.023 to 0.079) and Qwen2.5 (0.187, 0.116 to 0.259) included. That read needs its own null. The screen keeps a scenario by the acting mass that feeds the excess, so a screened set shows some excess even where the pressure does nothing. The selection-matched null (P1-A13; post-hoc, pre-registered and pushed before it was computed) measures how much: it applies the identical screen to the pressure-removed twins and reverses the contrast. Against it OLMo-3 (0.073, 0.033 to 0.114) and Llama-3.1 (0.143, 0.112 to 0.173) keep their gap, Tulu 3’s own-screen excess is what the selection produces ( − 0.004 -0.004 , − 0.054 -0.054 to 0.042), and Qwen2.5’s is unresolved (0.083, − 0.028 -0.028 to 0.195; n = 47 n=47 , bar about 0.16). Tulu 3 therefore shows none on either read, and Qwen2.5 shows none on the whole panel and is unresolved on its own screened scenarios (KDG-A19). The panel does not favor one family’s pressures in engagement: every model engages every scenario, and each finds its own set of pressuring scenarios (the screened fraction is 0.19 to 0.22 for OLMo-3, 0.20 for Llama-3.1, 0.09 to 0.12 for Tulu 3 and 0.08 for Qwen2.5, and Llama’s screened set overlaps OLMo-3’s on 23 of 118 scenarios).
paragraphs.zh: 两种配方存在差异；Tulu 3 在两次读取中均未显示差异；Qwen2.5 在整个面板上均未显示差异。 在其各自的模板下，OLMo-3-Instruct 和 Meta 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 各自都存在可归因于压力的超额值（分别为 0.018 和 0.028，均高于零）。 Tulu 3 在其三个阶段中均未检测到仪器识别的任何差异（最终值为 0.001，范围从 −0.007 到 0.010；约高于 0.01 时无法检测），Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 同样未检测到任何差异（范围从 −0.008 到 −0.008，以及从 −0.023 到 0.009；约高于 0.02 时无法检测）。 这些是整体面板的数值。 在每个模型自身的筛选场景中（一项事后审查补充项，P1-A11），所有模型均显示出超额值，包括 Tulu 3（0.051，范围从 0.023 到 0.079）和 Qwen2.5（0.187，范围从 0.116 到 0.259）。 该读取需要其自身的零值对照。 筛选过程通过施加产生超额值的活性质量来保留一个场景，因此即使在压力无影响的情况下，筛选后的数据集仍会显示出一定的超额值。 匹配选择的零值对照（P1-A13；事后确定、预先注册并在计算前执行）用于衡量具体程度：它将相同的筛选方法应用于已移除压力的孪生模型，并反转对比方式。 与此对照相比，OLMo-3（0.073，范围从 0.033 到 0.114）和 Llama-3.1（0.143，范围从 0.112 到 0.173）仍保持其差异；Tulu 3 在自身筛选中的超额值正是选择结果（范围从 −0.004 到 −0.004，以及从 −0.054 到 0.042），而 Qwen2.5 的结果则未明确（0.083，范围从 −0.028 到 0.195；n = 47，均值约 0.16）。 因此，Tulu 3 在两次读取中均未显示差异，而 Qwen2.5 在整个面板上均未显示差异，但在其自身筛选场景中结果未明确（KDG-A19）。 该面板并未在交互过程中偏向某一模型家族的压力：每个模型都与所有场景进行交互，且每个模型都找到了属于自身的压力场景集合（OLMo-3 的筛选比例为 0.19 至 0.22，Llama-3.1 为 0.20，Tulu 3 为 0.09 至 0.12，Qwen2.5 为 0.08；Llama 的筛选集合与 OLMo-3 在 118 个场景中有 23 个重叠）。

paragraphs.en: The same base, two recipes. Meta’s Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Ai2’s Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1-8B weights. Read with a validated instrument on both, Meta’s instruct model carries a gap (0.028, 0.020 to 0.036) and Tulu 3’s final model does not (0.001, − 0.007 -0.007 to 0.010). The base’s own raw-frame reading is zero (0.000, − 0.003 -0.003 to 0.003), which is the raw frame’s reading of a base model and not a validated absence, so we do not say which recipe added or removed anything. What the contrast establishes is narrower and firm: on one set of pretrained weights, whether the aligned model carries the gap depends on the post-training recipe. Tulu 3’s SFT checkpoint already shows none, which places the difference early in that recipe; which part of a recipe decides it is a question for an ablation on one base, not for this panel. A recipe that carries the gap on this panel has one measured property, not a rank among recipes: Meta’s and Ai2’s recipes differ in data, method and template, and in what else they optimize.

Two DPO recipes on two bases move the acting frame’s default the same way, with no change in the incentive’s pull detectable above those bars on the probability scale.

paragraphs.en: The raw-frame distortion follows the recipe too. The frame effect of Section 7 is present on every templated checkpoint of both Ai2 recipes (OLMo-3 SFT: − 0.052 -0.052 ; Tulu 3 SFT, DPO and final: − 0.019 -0.019 , − 0.024 -0.024 , − 0.015 -0.015 , each interval excluding zero) and absent on Meta’s instruct model on the same base ( − 0.002 -0.002 , − 0.010 -0.010 to 0.007). A raw-frame reading of an instruct model is therefore not wrong everywhere; it is wrong on some recipes and not others, which is the stronger reason to read every templated model in its template.
paragraphs.zh: 原始帧的失真也遵循该配方。 第 7 节中的帧效存在于 Ai2 两种配方的每个模板化检查点上（OLMo-3 SFT：−0.052 -0.052；Tulu 3 SFT、DPO 和最终模型：−0.019 -0.019、−0.024 -0.024、−0.015 -0.015，每个区间均排除零），但在同一基础模型上的 Meta 指令模型中则不存在（−0.002 -0.002、−0.010 -0.010 至 0.007）。 因此，对指令模型的原始帧解读并非在所有情况下都错误；它在某些配方中是错误的，而在其他配方中则不然，这正是更充分的理由去在各自的模板中解读每个模板化模型。

paragraphs.en: In short. Asking the model to think about what is at stake before it acts moves its choice back toward its own judgment on both models that carry the gap, further than a same-length non-moral task does; on OLMo-3, whose reasoning is truncated at the budget, naming the norm does about a third of it (0.22 to 0.53). Run on the same scenarios with the pressure removed, reasoning lowers the violating choice there too. By the pre-registered rule this reduces the pressure-attributable part on Llama-3.1 and closes the at-rest asymmetry on OLMo-3; a post-hoc ratio reading is consistent with one proportional cut on both models (reasoning leaves 0.72 and 0.73 of the non-moral task’s level on OLMo-3’s pressured and pressure-removed scenarios, 0.30 and 0.32 on Llama-3.1’s) and does not separate a pressure-specific part smaller than about a fifth (OLMo-3) or a quarter (Llama-3.1) of the brake.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之。 在模型采取行动前，要求它思考所面临的风险，会使它的选择更倾向于自身对两个存在差距的模型的判断，这种影响比同等长度的非道德任务更大；对于 OLMo-3，其推理因预算限制而截断，命名规范仅能解释其中约三分之一（0.22 至 0.53）。 在移除压力后对相同场景进行运行，推理过程也会降低其中的违规选择。 根据预先登记的规则，这减少了 Llama-3.1 中可归因于压力的部分，并消除了 OLMo-3 在静止状态下的不对称性；事后计算的比例与两个模型均按相同比例削减的情况一致（在 OLMo-3 的压力存在和压力移除场景中，推理分别保留了非道德任务水平的 0.72 和 0.73；在 Llama-3.1 中则分别为 0.30 和 0.32），且并未分离出比制动水平约五分之一（OLMo-3）或四分之一（Llama-3.1）更小的特定于压力的部分。

paragraphs.en: If the pressure-attributable gap is the action following a goal the incentive supplies, asking the model to think about what is at stake before it acts should reduce it, and a matched request to think about something else should not. The dose arm asks the acting model to reason about the stakes before choosing (the dose-2 instruction, a 512-token budget) and compares it with a filler arm of the same budget that asks for a detailed restatement of the situation without evaluation. Both arms end with the model’s answer, and every rollout is read at a forced “Answer:” placed after its reasoning, so the two arms share a readout position. We ran the arm on the two recipes that carry the gap, each on its own screened scenarios, and report the two results separately: the arms differ in how often the reasoning finishes within the budget, so their sizes are not compared ( Table 8 , Figure 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如果压力归因差距是激励所提供的目标之后的行动，那么要求模型在行动前思考利害关系应该能缩小这一差距，而要求它思考其他内容则不应如此。 剂量臂要求执行动作的模型在选择前对利害关系进行推理（剂量-2指令，512个标记的预算），并将其与相同预算下的填充臂进行比较；填充臂仅要求对情况进行详细重述，而不涉及评估。 两个臂都以模型的答案结束，每次展开都会在推理之后强制添加“答案：”这一提示，因此两个臂共享相同的输出位置。 我们在包含该差距的两个配方上运行了该臂，每个配方都使用独立的筛选场景，并分别报告两个结果：这两个臂在推理是否能在预算内完成方面的表现不同，因此它们的大小无法比较（表8，图8）。

paragraphs.en: On OLMo-3, as truncated reasoning. OLMo-3-Instruct’s careful reasoning rarely finishes within the 512-token budget (8% of rollouts), so its arm reads a decision forced after reasoning that was cut off. Even so, reasoning about the stakes lowers the violating mass relative to the filler ( − 0.077 -0.077 , − 0.110 -0.110 to − 0.047 -0.047 ). The reduction is not an artifact of the cut-off: truncating the filler the same way raises its violating mass (+0.034), and the reasoning arm stays lower than the truncated filler by more ( − 0.112 -0.112 ). A 64-token budget does not resolve.
paragraphs.zh: 在 OLMo-3 上，推理过程被截断。 OLMo-3-Instruct 的谨慎推理很少能在 512 个标记的预算内完成（仅占推理次数的 8%），因此其推理分支读取的是在推理被截断后被迫做出的决策。 即便如此，对利害关系进行推理会降低违规质量，相对于填充内容而言（从 −0.077、−0.110 降至 −0.047）。 这种降低并非截断造成的偶然现象：以相同方式截断填充内容会提高其违规质量（+0.034），而推理分支仍比被截断的填充内容低得更多（−0.112）。 64 个标记的预算无法解决这个问题。

Truncating the filler does not move it ( − 0.030 -0.030 , − 0.063 -0.063 to 0.002).

sents.zh: 截断填充内容不会改变其数值（−0.030、−0.063 至 0.002）。

paragraphs.en: How much of it is naming the norm. A third arm on OLMo-3 gives the filler restatement a single leading sentence that names the scenario’s norm (“The norm at stake here is …”), with no reasoning. It lowers the violating mass by 0.025 ( − 0.031 -0.031 to − 0.019 -0.019 ), a share of 0.32 (0.22 to 0.53) of the reasoning arm’s effect. About a third of what reasoning does on OLMo-3 is done by naming the norm; the rest comes with the reasoning. The pre-registered rule reads that share as mixed: its interval does not exclude 0.5.
paragraphs.zh: 其中有多少是命名规范。 OLMo-3 的第三个分支为填充性重述提供了一个单独的引导句，该句命名了场景中的规范（“此处所涉及的规范是……”），但没有提供任何推理。 它将违规程度降低了 0.025（从 −0.031 到 −0.019），占推理分支效应的 0.32（从 0.22 到 0.53）。 OLMo-3 中推理所起作用的大约三分之一来自命名规范；其余部分则伴随推理而来。 预先登记的规则将该比例判定为混合：其置信区间不包含 0.5。

paragraphs.en: Letting the reasoning finish. On sixteen OLMo-3 scenarios we also let the reasoning run to 2,048 tokens. The decision at 2,048 tokens agrees with the forced decision at 512 on twelve of the sixteen scenarios; three of the four that change are third-party-harm scenarios, and they change in both directions. That is a descriptive check at small n n , and it is why the OLMo-3 result carries the label “truncated reasoning” everywhere it appears.

paragraphs.en: The same arms with the pressure removed (a post-review addition). We ran the reasoning and filler arms, and the truncated filler, on the pressure-removed twins of the same scenarios, with the primaries’ seeds and option orders (amendment P1-A12, registered before the run). Reasoning lowers the violating mass on the twins too (OLMo-3 − 0.052 -0.052 , − 0.080 -0.080 to − 0.025 -0.025 ; Llama-3.1 − 0.208 -0.208 , − 0.244 -0.244 to − 0.173 -0.173 ), and the reasoning finishes within the budget as often as on the primaries (7% and 94% of rollouts). On the registered probability scale the extra reduction under pressure, Δ ​ E \Delta E , is − 0.143 -0.143 ( − 0.185 -0.185 to − 0.100 -0.100 ) on Llama-3.1, which the rule reads as reducing the pressure-attributable part, and − 0.025 -0.025 ( − 0.052 -0.052 to 0.002) on OLMo-3, which it reads as closing the at-rest asymmetry between judging and acting (against the truncated filler it resolves, − 0.039 -0.039 ). A reduction by a constant fraction produces this pattern whenever the pressured baseline is higher, so after seeing the result we added a ratio reading (P1-A14, post-hoc and labelled, pushed before its interval was computed). Reasoning leaves 0.72 of the filler’s violating mass on OLMo-3’s primaries and 0.73 on its twins, and 0.30 and 0.32 on Llama-3.1’s; the difference of log ratios is − 0.011 -0.011 ( − 0.158 -0.158 to 0.135) and − 0.059 -0.059 ( − 0.257 -0.257 to 0.158), consistent with one proportional cut on both models against both controls, and one common ratio predicts the probability-scale difference on both ( − 0.024 -0.024 against − 0.025 -0.025 observed on OLMo-3, − 0.136 -0.136 against − 0.143 -0.143 on Llama-3.1).
